links.note: OVERWRITE of 31566 'Which picture shows the first sparks', which is about locating the start of the revolt. 'Who all are present in Picture-1' is the closer-look exercise, 31560 'Who else is there'.
OVERWRITE of 31567 'Leaders of the revolt', which is Begum Hazrat Mahal and Maulvi Ahmedulla in 1857. Tipu of Mysore is the far-seeing ruler set against the short-sighted princes of 1757, i.e. 31561.

OVERWRITE of 31570 'The soldiers' grievance', which is pay, promotions and customs. Lotus flowers circulated among the sepoys are the signal of a coming revolt, so the item belongs with the first sparks, 31566.
OVERWRITE of 31558 'Pictures and speech bubbles', which is about how the chapter is read. Azimullah Khan naming Peshwa Nana Saheb as leader is 31567 'Leaders of the revolt'.
